Moist Chocolate Chip Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 24, 2010 - 12:43am

Ingredients




1 cup Butter or margarine
1 cup White sugar
1/2 cup Brown sugar
2 Eggs
2 teaspoons Vanilla
 cups Unsifted flour
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Baking soda
12 ounces Chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Here is a real good chocolate chip cookie recipe and they are real moist. 2 Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs, vanilla, salt and soda.Add flour 1 cup at a time, then 1/3 cup. Add chocolate chips. drop from teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 375 8 - 10 minutes. 3 * I use 1/2 butter and 1/2 margarine!!! This makes about 5 dozen - just a few more. 4 Real Good. They don't spread out much when baking. I had been looking for a long time to find a good chocolate chip cookie recipe. This is it.
